name: Credibility-aware Generation (CAG) Benchmark
description: A comprehensive benchmark covering three critical real-world scenarios to evaluate models' capabilities in discerning and processing information based on its credibility in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) settings.
reputation: A relatively new, niche benchmark from the original paper, with limited but growing use in RAG credibility evaluation research.
notes: Focuses on mitigating the impact of flawed information in retrieval-augmented generation by teaching models to be credibility-aware.
